points: Providers spend nearly $1 trillion on AI infrastructure in 2026 and a further $6 trillion in 2027-2030
Covering that needs $8.5 trillion in revenue by 2030; Gartner forecasts at most $3.6 trillion
Over 80% of neocloud providers predicted to cease independent operations by 2030
read: Gartner press release, 14 October 2026 (analyst Will Sommer)
take: Gartner says AI revenue cannot pay back planned data-centre capex. Expect provider consolidation; weigh neocloud dependency and contract terms in capacity deals.
title: Gartner: $3.5 trillion of AI infrastructure spend at risk of write-down
